set.body: Create a reusable proof surface for the compiler and backends. Acceptance: scene-level golden/structural tests for canonical point, line, text, axis, and scaled plots; SVG golden tests stay deterministic but no longer encode plot semantics; future Canvas/JVM backends can reuse the same scene conformance cases. Focused gate remains graphicsJVM/test graphicsJS/test graphicsSvgJVM/test graphicsSvgJS/test.
set.title: Graphics: build scene and renderer conformance tests
